scraped.title: Monetary Statistics, Credit & Interest Rate Statistics – Lot1
scraped.subtitle: Technical Assistance for Production and Harmonisation of Monetary Statistics, Credit and Interest Rate Statistics Lot 1
scraped.clientName: Ministry of Economy and Production Argentina
scraped.description: The project aimed to support the MERCOSUR Central Banks in harmonizing monetary, credit, and interest rate statistics to enhance regional economic cooperation. It focused on strengthening cooperation between the banks, developing common statistical indicators to analyze…
body: The project aimed to support the MERCOSUR Central Banks in harmonizing monetary, credit, and interest rate statistics to enhance regional economic cooperation. It focused on strengthening cooperation between the banks, developing common statistical indicators to analyze macroeconomic convergence, and building institutional capacities.

As a result, standardized indicators for monetary, credit, and interest rate statistics were created, along with a Harmonization Manual to guide the process. ICON-INSTITUT also provided assistance to Central Bank officials in producing reliable, comparable data sets, supporting regional economic coordination.
